description: This file is a shell script implementing a backend for IPv4-in-IPv6 tunneling, providing setup and teardown functions for the protocol, including configuration parsing, rule generation, and network interface management.

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel according to configuration variables, including rule creation, interface initialization, and network routing.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the tunnel, removes network settings, and cleans up configuration based on the map type.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the protocol, defining expected parameters.
